<?php
function startTarget348(int $x, $tail = 'D', ...$extra) {
    echo (int)is_int($x), '|', $x, '|', $tail, '|', $extra['named'], '|';
    $received = Fiber::suspend('Y');
    return $received;
}
$fiber = new Fiber('startTarget348');
$start = $fiber->start(...);
$copy = clone $start;
echo (int)($copy == $start), '|';
unset($start);
echo $copy(x: '7', named: 'N'), '|';
echo (int)($fiber->resume(29) === null), '|', $fiber->getReturn();

    echo 'T', $value, '|';
    $received = Fiber::suspend('Y');
    return $received;
});
$start = $target->start(...);
$parent = new Fiber(static function () use ($start) {
    echo 'P|';
    $value = $start(value: 'V');
    echo 'C', $value, '|';
    return 19;
});
echo (int)($parent->start() === null), '|';

<?php
$original = new Fiber(static function ($value) {
    echo 'O', (int)($value === $GLOBALS['other']), '|';
    Fiber::suspend('Y');
    return 47;
});
$other = new Fiber(static function () { echo 'X|'; return 53; });
$selected = $original;
$method = 'StArT';
$start = $selected->$method(...);
$method = 'resume';
echo $start(value: ($selected = $other)), '|';
echo (int)$original->isStarted(), (int)$other->isStarted(), (int)($selected === $other), '|';
$original->resume();
echo $original->getReturn();

<?php

try { $start->__invoke(startArgument348()); }
catch (FiberError $error) {
    echo $error->getMessage(), '|';
    foreach ($error->getTrace() as $row) {
        echo $row['function'], $row['type'], (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';
    }
}
try { $start(startArgument348()); }
catch (FiberError $error) {

        echo $row['function'], $row['type'], (int)isset($row['file']), (int)isset($row['line']), '|';

}

<?php
class StartPayload348 {
    function __destruct() {
        echo 'D', (int)($GLOBALS['weak']->get() === null), (int)($GLOBALS['weakCapture']->get() === null), '|';
    }
}
$fiber = new Fiber(static function ($payload) {
    try { Fiber::suspend('Y'); }
    finally { echo 'F|'; return 61; }
});
$weak = WeakReference::create($fiber);
$start = $fiber->start(...);
$weakCapture = WeakReference::create($start);
unset($fiber);
echo $start->__invoke(new StartPayload348()), '|';
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($start);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), (int)($weakCapture->get() === null);
